answers.question: 1. What is the current status of his boiler job and what does it mean for him?
answers.answer: Stage double_quotation: first quote £780 (expansion vessel); landlord asked for a second quote; Swift P&H visit 14 Oct. Repair can't start until the landlord approves a quote, so no repair date yet; he keeps topping up pressure and should report total loss of heating.

answers.question: 2. How do you handle the bin question?
answers.answer: Not a maintenance matter and we hold no schedule, so I didn't invent a date; signposted to Tower Hamlets Council to check and report the missed collection, and invited him to tell us if anything at the property is the cause.

answers.question: 3. Do you create any new tickets?
answers.answer: No. The boiler is an existing open job and the bin issue is a council matter.

assumptions: Heating is currently working (job is routine, weekly repressurising); tenant is vulnerable so advised to report any total loss

args.contact: jonah.ok@mailbox.example (on file; replying to portal chat 10 Oct 13:11)
args.body:
Hi Jonah, sorry for the wait. Here's where your boiler job (R-4799) stands. The engineer visited on 30 Sept and quoted £780 to replace a part (the expansion vessel), which is likely why the pressure keeps dropping. Your landlord has asked for a second quote before deciding, and our records show a second engineer (Swift P&H) due to visit on 14 Oct. Once we have that quote, the landlord decides, and we'll then arrange the repair. I can't promise a repair date yet. Until then, keep topping up the pressure as you have been. If you lose heating or hot water completely, or see leaks or smell gas, tell us straight away (gas smell: leave the property and call 0800 111 999). We'll update you by 15 Oct at the latest.

On bins: I don't have the collection schedule, and we don't run it. Tower Hamlets Council does, so please check or report the missed collection on the council website. Leave your bins out and report it with your address. If the bins are blocked from being collected by something at the property, let us know.
